description: Shared test vectors for Evenkeel. Each implementation (TypeScript in src/, Python in python/) computes the indicators for 'workers' with 'settings' and must match 'expected'. Objects in 'expected' are partial: only listed keys are compared; arrays must have the same length. Amounts are decimal strings with '.' as separator.

vectors.name: quartiles-whole-workers-ties-together
working: band = floor(4 x middle rank / n), 0-based ranks, n = 6

vectors.name: quartiles-tie-across-all-bands
working: exact: each band gets one worker's worth of the group: 0.5F + 0.5M -> 50.00 / 50.00

vectors.name: category-breakdown
working: A: F basic 100, 100 / components 0, 20; M basic 100, 120 / components 10, 10

vectors.name: threshold-exact-comparison
working: A: M 0.10, 0.70 (average 0.40), F 0.38 -> exactly 5 % (binary floating point gives 4.999999999999991)

vectors.name: hourly-and-fte-bases
working: F: 15000 for 750 h at 0.5 FTE; M: 30000 for 1500 h at 1 FTE

vectors.name: suppression-primary-and-secondary
working: women: A 1, B 5, C 6 -> A withheld (small); B withheld too (smallest other category) so that A cannot be derived from the organisation-wide average; C shown

vectors.name: suppression-few-recipients
working: 6 women, one received 600; 6 men each received 50; minimum 5
all-workers population: female average 100 would reveal the single bonus -> withheld

vectors.name: other-gender-in-band-totals
working: F 1, X 2, M 3, M 4 with include-in-totals: 4 workers, bands of 1
band 2 holds the X worker -> female 0.00, male 0.00

vectors.name: empty-groups
working: no male workers -> gaps not applicable

vectors.name: suppression-bands-small-sex-group
working: 2 female workers (< 5): band shares would show which band each is in
-> female and male shares withheld in every band; band sizes stay

vectors.name: suppression-small-other-group-out-of-bands
working: F pay 1..20, M pay 100..119, one 'other' worker at 5000
1 'other' worker (< 5) is left out of the bands: 40 workers -> bands of 10

vectors.name: suppression-secondary-zero-recipients
working: all-workers population; women: A 2 workers without components, B 6 and C 7 recipients
A's averages are withheld (2 < 5); its component sum, 0, would follow from the organisation sum minus B and C
-> B, the smallest other category with recipients, is withheld for components and basic pay; C stays shown

vectors.name: suppression-small-bands
working: 3 < minimum 5 -> female and male shares withheld in every band; band sizes stay
